title: Sources: Trump and JD Vance were convinced Jensen Huang alone protected American-made open-weight AI models (Reuters)
summary: Reuters: Sources: Trump and JD Vance were convinced Jensen Huang alone protected American-made open-weight AI models — US President Donald Trump and Vice President JD Vance personally intervened in Nvidia's (NVDA.O) decision to reinstate CEO Jensen Huang over the weekend, convinced he alone protected American …
